title: Spring Boot 3.5.0 to 4.1.1 on Java 21
summary: The application moved from Spring Boot 3.5.0 on Java 17 to Spring Boot 4.1.1 on Java 21. The business API is unchanged: the same nine employee endpoints answer with the same payloads and the same authentication. What did change is everything the framework touches directly — JSON serialisation moved to Jackson 3, the health indicator moved package, the web starter was renamed, and the controller test had to be rewritten against the new test annotations. Three build rounds were needed; all nine runtime probes return identical responses before and after.

dependency_changes.reason: The parent BOM drives every managed version; nothing else can move until it does.
Boot 4 splits the web starters by stack; the servlet MVC stack is now named webmvc.
Boot 4 requires Java 21 as its baseline.

code_changes.what: Replaced the Jackson 2 ObjectMapper bean with a JsonMapper builder customizer and moved every import to the tools.jackson namespace.
code_changes.why: Boot 4 ships Jackson 3, which relocates the databind package and replaces the ObjectMapper configuration entry point.

code_changes.what: Changed the Health and HealthIndicator imports to the new actuator health package.
code_changes.why: Actuator's health contributor types moved out of org.springframework.boot.actuate.health into org.springframework.boot.health.contributor.

round_notes.diagnosis: Pre-migration reference build on Java 17. Green, all tests passing, and all nine probes answering — this is the behaviour the migrated build has to reproduce.
First build after the dependency swap, still on Java 17. It failed on the release level before reaching any source: Boot 4 requires Java 21. Nothing about the source code was learned in this round.
changes: Switched the build to JDK 21 and set java.version to 21.

round_notes.diagnosis: First real compile on JDK 21. Forty-two errors in four files, all of one shape: packages that no longer exist. Jackson's databind package and Actuator's health package both moved, and the test module's mock annotation was removed.
changes: Rewrote JacksonConfig against the Jackson 3 builder API.
Replaced @MockBean with @MockitoBean in the controller test.

round_notes.diagnosis: Green: compiled, packaged and all tests passing on JDK 21.

behaviour.notes: All nine probes return the same status, content type and body hash before and after. Startup time moved from 3.1s to 2.8s, which is within noise.

out_of_scope_changes.change: Added EmployeeRepository.findByEmail() and corrected the uniqueness check that used findByEmployeeNumber().
out_of_scope_changes.why_separate: This is a pre-existing logic bug. It is not caused by the version jump and should be reviewed and merged as its own change.

manual_follow_ups: Update the deployment pipeline's build image to a Java 21 JDK.
Re-run the performance suite: the runtime probes prove correctness, not throughput.
residual_risk: Only the endpoints listed in the probe file were exercised; any route not in that list is unproven.
The H2 file database was used for both runs — PostgreSQL-specific behaviour under Hibernate 7 is untested here.
